text:
maria: Hey team — scheduling panel for Samir Patel (SWE-II). Interview block is Thurs 3/26 10:00-11:30 PT. Need: availability, someone to cover system-design, and quick rubric clarifications. @ashok @jordan @sylvia
ashok: I can do the block but prefer a 10:30 start if possible (conflict until 10). Ok to shift?
jordan: I have a calendar conflict 10:15-10:45, so I can't cover system design. I can do coding + behavioral.
sylvia: I can cover system design and ownership. Confirming timezone — PT = Pacific, right?
maria: Yes PT. If we shift to 10:30-12:00 PT that could fit everyone. @recruiter-bot can you re-run availability poll?
recruiter-bot: Poll created -> https://cal.poll/samir-panel (closes in 24h). I'll update calendar invites after confirmation.
ashok: 10:30 works for me. I'll focus on design + coding. @jordan do you want to swap coding with me?
jordan: Sure, happy to swap — I'll take behavioral + coding follow-up. Quick rubric Q: how are we weighting 'ownership' vs 'system design'? Link to rubric v3?
maria: Good Q. We weight: Coding 30%, System Design 35%, Ownership/Behavioral 20%, Culture Add 15%. Use 1-5 per area and add 1-2 bullet notes. Use this template:
```
Coding: 4
System Design: 4
Ownership: 3
Culture Add: 4
Notes: Async APIs solid; needs stronger testing plan. Recommend hire with concerns?
```
sylvia: For system design scoring, prioritize architecture tradeoffs and scalability, not just diagram completeness.
jordan: Noted. Also debrief timing — usually we do a 30-min sync right after the interview in #hiring-debrief. Can folks do a 20-min async notes doc instead if they're tight?
maria: Let's keep the 30-min slot in calendar but if you're tight you can drop short notes in the candidate doc: https://docs.company/samir-debrief. Final decision goes in Greenhouse.
nashok: :thumbsup: I'll add my notes. One more ask — can someone ping ops to reserve Conference Room B for the panel (in case candidate wants hybrid)?
recruiter-bot: Room B reserved tentatively. Calendar invite will show location once poll closes.
sylvia: Added a quick checklist to the candidate doc about eval focus. @maria I'll watch the schedule and ping if we need to move.
maria: Perfect. Final ask: if you can't make the confirmed time, please swap at least 24h before or let me know and we'll find backup. Thanks! :raised_hands:
